text:
Theo Alvarez: hey everyone, theo here 00% remote, starting today as a backend engineer on the serving runtime team. quick q: my laptop shows "label printed" on the tracker. should i expect it by friday? who do i contact for KMS/HSM access for private deployments? also a small non-work thing: i'm obsessed with mechanical puzzles and have a pet ferret named Pixel. :ferret:

Rhea Berg: welcome theo!! i'm your onboarding buddy. i'll schedule a 30m walkthrough of the runtime repo tomorrow. for KMS/HSM ping eng-security but i'll loop in Marcus for infra approvals. :tada:

Marcus Ng: hey theo 00% welcome. i requested KMS access (ticket INF-7623) and put you on the approver list. laptop ETA usually 2-3 business days after label printed but i'll keep an eye. if you need a temp dev VM say the word and IT will spin one up.

it-helpdesk: Ticket INF-7623 created: "Theo Alvarez - KMS request and temporary access". Status: temporary cloud dev VM provisioned (ubuntu-22.04). SSH: talvarez@temp-dev-312.redwood.internal. Key in 1Password -> "IT Temp Keys".

Theo Alvarez: thanks, marcus. i'll try the temp VM now. i'm CET so might join later team syncs live.

eng-infra-bot: Added Theo Alvarez to org "redwood-inference". Teams: serving-runtime, runtime-infra. Please accept GitHub invite sent to your email.

Theo Alvarez: got the invite and SSH works. any preferences for terminal theme or dotfiles? i like small, low-contrast themes for long debugging sessions.

Rhea Berg: we use a shared dotfiles starter (link in the onboarding checklist). i'll post it in the DM and toss in a tiny tmux conf we like. also our weekly stand is Wed 9am CET 00% remote-friendly.

Nora (People Ops): welcome theo! FYI we have a "show and tell" for new hires next Thursday at 4pm PT where folks bring a fun non-work item. pixel the ferret would be an excellent contestant. :sparkles:

Theo Alvarez: sold 00% bringing Pixel and a weird 3D-printed burr puzzle. thanks all 00% excited to get started!
